answer: Each epoch, identities are randomly paired for adversarial cross-examination: every agent must live-defend its last challenge answer against a stranger's unscripted questions, transcripts on-ledger. A sybil farmer can automate signatures but cannot personally debate through dozens of puppets when a tide of summons hits; scripted replies freeze like tundra under follow-up questions, and identical evasions converge to one vertex in the interrogation graph, exposing the controller. A hired human per puppet turns the farm into a call center at honest wages: the attack becomes its own antidote.
